channel.title: CIS 561 - Introduction to Data Science in Practice :: CS Two Year Refactor
channel.description: Course Description The development and implementation of computer science solutions to practical data science problems in science and industry. Implementing computer programs and applying computational tools to turn real-world data into knowledge and solve real-world data science problems. Includes a substantial capstone component. Credit Hours 3 credits Course Goals and Learning Outcomes TBD Course Prerequisites TBD
